items.title: Reggie Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018
items.q: And I’ll never forget, the guy’s name was Todd. He played lead trombone but he played valve trombone. And everything came together.

ctx.x: Well there must have been some inspiration then, from that point on.

Well it was good that they brought me in the high school, it’s nice to have something that you feel like you belong to. Even before classes started I had a sense of belonging to the band you know? And that first year of marching band was really exciting and then it turned out that all my friends were trombone players. So I wanted to be in the trombone section. And there was kind of a light bulb moment where as a sophomore they had a seniors perform for us. Like they brought in all the music kids and they had the…
Do you recall what arrangements, what was the style back then?
